details.playable: Click an asteroid pack, then Send ore to..., then a planet that buys ore: a route is made and a ship bought if none is free.
details.how_to_try: Learn FND_PROSPECT (Prospecting, K screen; the card button is hidden without it, tutorial must be done or skipped). Click an asteroid pack on the map (the cluster card opens with name, ore per cycle, ore left). Press Send ore to... (top line says: Send ore from Asteroid cluster ...: click the destination planet, Esc to cancel). Click a planet that buys ore: route created through the normal send path (buys a ship if none free, same refusal notices). With too little cash the red line and cursor warning show. Esc or a click on empty space cancels. Not shown if the cluster has no ore left.

Added main._on_cluster_send(index): pending={planet: cluster node (negative id), c: ore}. pending_margin_lines skips cluster sources (no planet margins); route_warning.gd draws the red line from the pack centre (preload Clusters added). Test _test_cluster_send in tools/tests/run_tests.gd.
